result.message: `/opt/acme` has 80 GiB free on its file system (btrfs). 20 GiB is needed.
notes: This file system keeps no inode count, so inodes were not checked.

No line in /proc/self/mountinfo has device 0:45. A btrfs subvolume has a device number of its own, so rdy matched the btrfs mount `/` by its mount point. The path may go through a link, so the type is a best guess and nodev is not checked.
